example.title: George Cather Farmstead, barn, 552 Road T

brief: Old gable-roofed barn about 36 ft wide and 48 ft long, its walls clad entirely in wood shingles weathered to dark silver-brown, with a small square loft window high in the gable and a steep wood-shingle roof going mossy and ragged at the eaves. Along the long side a low shed-roofed lean-to on posts forms an open machinery bay the full length of the barn, now filled with a green grain drill and wagons. The barnyard around it is crowded with old implements, disc harrows and a yellow grain auger; four corrugated steel grain bins with conical roofs and dark cedars stand nearby. (Wood-shingled gable barn with open-front lean-to; nearest vocabulary type is english_three_bay.)
